name: mudrpc
description: Mud RPC: gRPC for unstable networks. gRPC's service model over mesh, radio and UDP as sealed packets, without HTTP/2 or a server stack; the C ABI as a static library with mudrpc.h, and mud.hpp and mud_grpc.hpp over it so the code protoc generates runs with the include changed. Built by cargo, which the port needs on the path.
